sourceItems.title: 2022年1—2月份全国规模以上工业企业利润增长5.0%
normalizedClaims: Jan-Feb mining profits +132% YoY; oil/gas extraction +156.7%; coal mining +155.3%, while manufacturing profit -4.2% and power/heat profit -49.1%.

sourceItems.title: Oil surges to multi-year highs as Russian supply shortfall looms
normalizedClaims: Brent rose 21% in one week as buyers shunned Russian crude after the invasion, creating a large physical/financial supply shock.

sourceItems.title: Oil surges as U.S. bans Russian crude, Britain to phase out purchases
normalizedClaims: Oil prices were more than 30% above pre-invasion levels as U.S./UK restrictions increased expected Russian supply disruption.

sourceItems.title: Nutrien to increase potash production amid Eastern Europe supply worries
normalizedClaims: Russia and Belarus supply uncertainty pushed global potash prices sharply higher; Nutrien planned additional output to offset disrupted supply.

sourceItems.title: As sanctions bite Russia, fertilizer shortage imperils world food supply
normalizedClaims: Russia/Belarus accounted for over 40% of global potash exports and significant nitrogen/phosphate exports; sanctions/shipping disruption drove fertilizer prices high enough to change planting and input decisions.

sourceItems.title: DDR3 Consumer DRAM Prices Expected to Rise by 0-5% in 2Q22 Due to Rapidly Shrinking Supply
normalizedClaims: Major suppliers were accelerating DDR3 production exits while networking-chip supply and demand improved; TrendForce expected DDR3 prices to rise in Q2 despite broader DRAM transition to DDR5.

sourceItems.title: Ukrainian-Russian Conflict Affects Semiconductor Gas Supply and May Cause Rise in Chip Production Costs
normalizedClaims: Ukraine represented a large share of global neon capacity, but semiconductor fabs had inventories/alternative supply and TrendForce did not expect short-term production stoppages; cost risk was more credible than immediate volume shortage.

sourceItems.title: LME forced to halt nickel trading after prices top $100,000
normalizedClaims: Nickel more than doubled to above $100,000/t amid Russian supply concerns and a short squeeze; LME halted trading and cancelled trades.

sourceItems.title: Tesla to suspend Shanghai production as city locks down
normalizedClaims: Shanghai lockdown measures forced Tesla to suspend production and disrupted local industrial operations.

sourceItems.title: 2022年3月中国采购经理指数运行情况
normalizedClaims: March manufacturing PMI fell to 49.5; production 49.5 and new orders 48.8. Input-price index rose to 66.1 amid geopolitical commodity inflation, while supplier delivery time fell to 46.5.

eventClusters.statement: Russia's invasion and sanctions/shunning of Russian barrels drove a rapid oil supply shock while official Chinese data already showed oil/gas and coal extraction profits more than doubling, creating a realized upstream profit transfer with substantial price-absorption risk.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Current upstream profits are real but commodity prices rerated extremely quickly. Deep research must freeze the full earnings path and distinguish durable low-cost economics from peak-price extrapolation.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which A-share upstream producer had incremental near/next/later earnings-path room after the March commodity rerating?

eventClusters.statement: Russia/Belarus supply disruption turned already-high fertilizer prices into a global physical shortage, especially potash, creating a potential scarcity profit pool but also a classic peak-price duration question.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: High fertilizer prices can boost producers while destroying downstream demand and encouraging new supply. Company selection must compare the frozen earnings path, not spot price alone.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Did any A-share potash/fertilizer producer have a durable cost/supply advantage that improved the full earnings path beyond the already-high price baseline?

eventClusters.statement: Legacy DDR3 supply was shrinking as major memory suppliers migrated capacity toward newer generations, while networking demand improved, creating a narrow structural pricing opportunity inside an otherwise mixed memory market.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The signal is niche and single-origin. Deep research must verify listed-company DDR3 revenue exposure and whether earnings conversion is material enough to matter.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which A-share memory company had verified DDR3 exposure, direct price-to-profit conversion and expectation-path room?

eventClusters.statement: Nickel prices briefly exceeded $100,000/t and LME suspended/cancelled trades, but the move was heavily driven by short covering and market disorder rather than a clean, investable physical-price signal.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: A disorderly squeeze cannot be treated as sustainable realized-price evidence. Company hedges/short exposure can invert apparent beneficiaries.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Reject generic nickel-long mapping unless company economics are independently verified after the market disorder.

eventClusters.statement: Ukraine neon supply risk could raise semiconductor production costs, but specialist evidence explicitly indicated fab inventories and alternative supply should prevent near-term production stoppages.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Headline supply exposure is large but near-term operating incidence is explicitly limited.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Use as semiconductor cost-risk context rather than a standalone long opportunity.

eventClusters.statement: Late-March Shanghai restrictions created real auto/manufacturing disruption while official PMI fell below 50, input costs surged and delivery times worsened.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: This is primarily a negative timing/regime shock and may dominate optimistic company extrapolations.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Use as contradiction and timing context, not a standalone long selection.
